patterns.what_worked: Auditing all 82 CreateFontString sites before touching anything kept the diff small: the defect class existed in exactly one file (hunter_ui.lua, 4 sites). The shared chain went into utils.lua - already in all 7 TOCs and loaded before every consumer - so no TOC edit was needed and no client could load a build with a missing font module.
patterns.what_was_hard: The sandbox had to become SoD-faithful (SetText with no font throws) for the pins to be load-bearing, and a font-stripped mutant therefore aborts the suite with the client's exact error instead of a clean FAIL line; M5 was added to prove the source-order pin independently of the crash. bars_state's fontstring stub had to learn that a nil path latches nothing, or the bars degradation pin would have passed against the old buggy code.
patterns.skill_gap: Reading a bench citation's line number is a claim, not a fact - the first draft of the bench file cited the pre-fix hunter_ui line numbers for the badge/label writes and was corrected by re-reading the file.
